holdings.name: iShares Core S&P/TSX Capped Composite Index ETF
holdings.rationale: Domestic core: broad Canadian large, mid and small caps with no currency translation.

holdings.name: iShares Core S&P U.S. Total Market Index ETF
holdings.rationale: Largest equity market; unhedged so USD exposure diversifies Canadian-dollar risk.

holdings.name: iShares Core MSCI EAFE IMI Index ETF
holdings.rationale: Europe, Australasia and Far East exposure that is not tied to the North American cycle.

holdings.name: iShares Core MSCI Emerging Markets IMI Index ETF
holdings.rationale: Small strategic allocation to faster-growing, higher-volatility economies.

holdings.name: iShares Core Canadian Universe Bond Index ETF
holdings.rationale: Core fixed income: government and investment-grade corporate bonds across maturities.

holdings.name: iShares Core Canadian Short Term Bond Index ETF
holdings.rationale: Lower interest-rate sensitivity and a liquidity reserve inside the bond sleeve.

holdings.name: iShares U.S. High Yield Bond Index ETF (CAD-Hedged)
holdings.rationale: Small credit-risk income allocation; currency hedged so returns are not driven by USD/CAD.

benchmark.name: Vanguard Balanced ETF Portfolio
benchmark.rationale: A different issuer's 60/40 global balanced fund of index ETFs, priced in CAD. It shares the portfolio's 60/40 risk budget but not its holdings or regional weights, so the comparison shows the effect of allocation choices.

rebalance.convention: Threshold review at each month-end close. If any asset-class weight is more than 2.0 pp from target, or any holding more than 1.5 pp from target, the portfolio is assumed rebalanced to target at that close. Otherwise the drifted weights carry into the next month. The first edition starts at target on the inception date.
